tactics:
induction p with
| nil => simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
| cons kv p ih =>
  obtain ⟨k, v⟩ := kv
  simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero] at h
  simp only [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote]
  split at h
  · subst_vars
    simp [Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.fixedVar] at *
    omega
  · have := ih h
    omega
induction p <;> grind [Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.isNonZero, Nat.Internal.Linear.Poly.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.Var.denote, Nat.Internal.Linear.fixedVar]
